text:
We were delighted to host the incredible volunteer team behind this group for a team building day!

Kathrin, Inbar, Anja, Jordan, Lior Gorodisky,  Lior Beres and April! 

Alongside the fun, we included quite a bit of work to make sure this community continues to be the supportive and valuable space it is today.

Please join us in showing some appreciation to these amazing volunteers, who dedicate so much of their free time to helping other couples navigate their journeys – and quite literally volunteer for LOVE 💙

Interested in joining us and volunteering as a group moderator? Check the comments 👇
